caption: The drawing depicts a decorative ironwork element consisting of a central circular medallion enclosing a horse in a rearing position, with its tail and mane stylized and detailed. The horse faces to the right. Surrounding the circle is ornate scrollwork and symmetrical extensions radiating outward, featuring curved and angular elements. The entire composition is horizontally bisected by two parallel straight bars, which pass through the design and extend beyond its edges. The artwork appears in shades of black and gray, with the ironwork set against a plain, light-colored background. The artist's name, Pearl Torelli, is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Fence - Sea Horse Design
